display_name: Restart the solet via local blue-green swap
description: Plugin-namespace registration that backs the service-interface verb service_interface::self_deployment_service::restart_with_manifest when the local profile binds self_deployment_service: macos_self_deployment_plugin. Initiates the 10-step blue-green swap: probe current active color via the local-blue-green router, spawn the opposite color via `python -m ananta.cli` with SOLET_COLOR set, poll the router until green registers ready, atomically activate green, set_active(False) on blue's lifecycle-managed plugins, enqueue a durable complete_swap action for green's action_queue_poller to pick up. Returns a RestartResult envelope with status (queued/failed/needs_intervention), restart_action_id, message, reason, expected_etag, dry_run, and a machine-readable reason_code. Sync from the caller's perspective per D6'; backgrounding via scheduling_service::execute_in_seconds. Omitting dry_run performs no action; dry_run=true plans the swap without spawning green or touching router state. Malformed dry_run values are refused before router or process activity.
embedding_description: Restart the solet on macOS through the local blue-green router swap: read the active color, launch the opposite color with the new manifest, wait for it to come ready, then activate it atomically so the switch lands without downtime. The local-profile restart path used when new code or a changed plugin manifest needs to take effect.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: RestartResult envelope: status (queued/failed/needs_intervention), restart_action_id, message, reason, expected_etag, dry_run flag, and the machine-readable reason_code.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. If 'queued', surface restart_action_id (the pollable complete_swap finisher) + message + reason. If 'failed', surface message + reason_code verbatim — the system is unchanged and the operator may retry. If 'needs_intervention', surface message + reason_code prominently — automated recovery is exhausted (e.g. a failed cutover whose router rollback did not take, candidate left alive) and a human must act. dry_run=true returns a planned-swap envelope without spawning or touching router state.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Local blue-green solet restart via L3 router.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: router_unavailable: ~/.ananta/runtime/<name>.router.sock not present or unreachable; install via plugins/macos_self_deployment_plugin/src/macos_self_deployment_plugin/blue_green_router/install_router.py. spawn_failed: `python -m ananta.cli` subprocess failed to start; check the new color's stderr. green_did_not_become_ready: spawn succeeded but green did not register with the router within the ready timeout; check green's prepare_for_readiness errors. activate_refused: router rejected the activate call (port_out_of_band, color_already_active, or similar); check router logs.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If router is unavailable, install via the install_router.py script and retry. If green did not become ready, the failure envelope carries the new color's exit-cause from the router's status() output; surface that to the operator for inspection. swap_rollback can revert routing back to blue if green is still inside its drain window.
